description: Derived from AGSC-01-14: its encoding obligations bind every `.md` file of the Bundle, not only the items under `content/`, and each fault is AGSC-E108, an error. Two Markdown files outside `content/` are added to the minimal fixture, each with CRLF line endings and conforming otherwise: the root privacy notice PRIVACY.md and a site page site/page.md. The whole list `lint` reports is two AGSC-E108 errors, one naming each file, and lint exits 1. Neither file is an item, so neither finding carries a `slug`. The vector stays ASCII and LF: each carriage return is a JSON escape.

add_files.PRIVACY.md:
# Privacy

This node keeps no personal data.
add_files.site/page.md:
# Page

A page of the site.
